title: 4 Claude Code features most people never set up

creative_direction.core_message: Four built-in features turn Claude Code from a chat into a configured teammate.
creative_direction.viewer_benefit: Set up one feature tonight and stop repeating yourself.
creative_direction.hook: 4 Claude Code features most people never set up.
creative_direction.sound_design: impact on hook, typing ticks, chime on the CTA

claims.text: Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md into context at the start of every session.
Markdown files in .claude/commands become custom slash commands.
Hooks are shell commands that run at lifecycle events and can block a tool call.
Subagents work in their own separate context window.

scenes.narration: Four Claude Code features most people never set up.
scenes.heading: 4 Claude Code features you're skipping

scenes.narration: Number 1: CLAUDE.md. Claude reads it at the start of every session, so your build commands and rules never need repeating.
scenes.heading: Your project's memory
scenes.label: CLAUDE.md

scenes.narration: Number 2: custom slash commands. Drop a Markdown file in dot claude slash commands, and a saved prompt runs as one command.
scenes.heading: Prompts as commands
scenes.label: Slash commands

scenes.narration: Number 3: hooks. Shell commands that run automatically before or after a tool call, like a linter after every edit.
scenes.heading: Automate the guardrails
scenes.label: Hooks

scenes.narration: Number 4: subagents. Each one has its own instructions, tools, and context window, so research never clutters your main chat.
scenes.heading: Specialists on call
scenes.label: Subagents

scenes.narration: Save this, and set one up before your next session.
scenes.heading: Save this. Set one up.
